test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid email and strong password
preconditions: User account exists with email and password that meets policy
steps: 2. Enter a registered email in Email/Username field
3. Enter the correct password (>=8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special)
test_cases.expected_result: Page flashes 'Signed in successfully.' and redirects to Accounts Overview showing the user's accounts and left-hand navigation

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with incorrect password
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.' is displayed; password field is cleared and Email field remains populated

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with invalid email format
steps: 2. Enter any password that meets policy
test_cases.expected_result: Client-side validation prevents submission and shows 'Enter a valid email address' (or similar); no authentication attempt is made

test_cases.test_case: Login with missing password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation highlights Password as required; no authentication attempt; appropriate error message shown

test_cases.test_case: Login with maximum length email and password characters
preconditions: User account exists with long credentials within allowed limits
steps: 1. Enter the maximum allowed length email/username
2. Enter the maximum allowed length password that meets complexity
test_cases.expected_result: Authentication proceeds and on success shows 'Signed in successfully.' and redirects to Accounts Overview; no truncation or errors occur

test_cases.test_case: Left-hand navigation contains all expected options after login
steps: 1. Observe the left-hand navigation menu on Accounts Overview
test_cases.expected_result: Menu contains Accounts Overview, Open New Account, Transfer Funds, Bill Pay, Request Loan, Update Contact Info, Manage Cards, Investments, Account Statements, Security Settings, Support Center, and Log Out

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with SQL injection string in username
test_cases.expected_result: Input is sanitized; authentication fails with 'Incorrect email or password' or validation error; no system compromise

test_cases.test_case: Successful user registration with valid data
steps: 2. Fill First Name, Last Name, Street Address, City
4. Enter valid ZIP (12345), Phone (1234567890 -> should auto-format), SSN (123456789 -> auto-format), Username (valid email), Password (meets policy), Confirm Password (matches)
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Account created successfully — please sign in' and redirects to login page

test_cases.test_case: Registration fails when required fields are missing
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error highlights First Name as required and prevents registration; form remains editable

test_cases.test_case: Registration rejects mismatched password and confirm password
preconditions: Registration form filled except matching passwords
test_cases.expected_result: Validation shows 'Passwords do not match' and prevents account creation

test_cases.test_case: Registration with invalid phone format
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error indicates invalid phone number format; automatic formatting either corrects or user must correct; registration blocked

test_cases.test_case: Registration with invalid SSN format
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error displayed for SSN field; account not created

test_cases.test_case: Register with ZIP+4 format (12345-6789) and phone automatic formatting
steps: 2. Enter Phone as digits '1234567890' and observe auto-format to '(123) 456-7890'
3. Fill other fields correctly and Register
test_cases.expected_result: Registration succeeds and shows 'Account created successfully — please sign in'; phone displays formatted value

test_cases.test_case: Accounts Overview displays all accounts with masked account numbers and total footer
preconditions: User logged in with multiple accounts
steps: 2. Observe accounts table rows and footer
test_cases.expected_result: Each account row shows masked account number (**** last 4 digits), account type, balance, Active badge, open date; footer shows total balance across accounts; rows ordered earliest first

test_cases.test_case: Accounts Overview with zero-balance account and very large balance
preconditions: User has an account with $0.00 and another with very large balance
test_cases.expected_result: Zero-balance displays as $0.00; very large balance displays correctly (no overflow) and is included in total; formatting consistent

test_cases.test_case: Accounts Overview handles missing account data gracefully
preconditions: User account exists but one account has missing open date
test_cases.expected_result: Missing field displays placeholder like 'N/A' or '-' and page does not crash

test_cases.test_case: Open new Checking account with minimum deposit
steps: 4. Select Funding Source account with sufficient funds
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Account opened successfully!' and redirects to Accounts Overview where new Checking account appears

test_cases.test_case: Open new Savings account with above-minimum deposit
test_cases.expected_result: 'Account opened successfully!' message shown and Accounts Overview shows the new Savings account

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open account without selecting account type
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation shows 'Please select an account type'; account is not created

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open Savings with deposit below $100
test_cases.expected_result: Real-time validation displays 'Minimum deposit for Savings is $100' and prevents submission

test_cases.test_case: Open Checking account with deposit equal to $25 boundary
test_cases.expected_result: Account opened successfully and appears in Accounts Overview; funding account balance reduced by $25

test_cases.test_case: Internal transfer between two ParaBank accounts
preconditions: At least two Checking/Savings accounts exist with sufficient funds in source
steps: 3. Enter a valid transfer amount less than or equal to source balance
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Transfer completed successfully.' with a transaction ID; Accounts Overview shows updated balances

test_cases.test_case: Attempt transfer with amount exceeding source balance
steps: 3. Enter amount greater than source balance
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Insufficient funds' displayed; transfer not processed

test_cases.test_case: External transfer with mismatched account numbers
steps: 3. Enter Destination Account Number '12345678' and Confirm '87654321'
4. Enter valid transfer amount within source balance
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Account numbers do not match.' displayed; transfer aborted

test_cases.test_case: Transfer with decimal amount at cents boundary (e.g., $0.01)
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer completes successfully and balances update accordingly; UI handles small decimal amounts

test_cases.test_case: Submit bill payment to a new payee with sufficient funds
steps: 2. Enter Payee Name, Address, City, State, ZIP, Phone
3. Enter Payee Account Number and Confirm Account Number (matching)
4. Enter Payment Amount within funding account balance
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Payment submitted successfully.' with a reference code; source account balance updated

test_cases.test_case: Attempt bill payment with mismatched payee account numbers
steps: 2. Enter Payee Account Number '111222' and Confirm '333444'
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Account numbers do not match' displayed; payment not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Attempt bill payment with insufficient funds
steps: 2. Enter payment amount greater than source balance
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Insufficient funds' displayed; payment not processed

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment with payment amount at $0.01 and formatted phone number
steps: 3. Enter phone as digits and observe formatting
4. Complete other fields and Click Pay
test_cases.expected_result: Payment is processed successfully; phone appears formatted; reference code shown

test_cases.test_case: Request and receive approval for a Personal loan meeting down payment and credit criteria
preconditions: Credit engine simulation results in approval (80% chance)
steps: 4. Enter Down Payment >= 10% and less than loan amount
5. Select Collateral Account meeting 20% collateral value requirement
test_cases.expected_result: If simulated credit approves, displays 'Loan approved and created successfully!' with account details; otherwise denial message with reason

test_cases.test_case: Request loan with amount below allowed range
steps: 2. Choose Auto loan but enter amount '4000' (below $5,000)
3. Fill Down Payment and Collateral fields appropriately
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Loan amount must be between $5,000 and $75,000 for Auto loans' shown; request rejected

test_cases.test_case: Request loan with down payment equal to or greater than loan amount
steps: 2. Enter Loan Amount '10000' and Down Payment '10000' or higher
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Down payment must be less than loan amount' displayed

test_cases.test_case: Request Home loan with amount exactly at upper boundary ($500,000)
steps: 3. Enter valid Down Payment meeting minimum requirement
test_cases.expected_result: Loan request validated; credit engine may approve or deny; if approved, success message appears; UI handles boundary value

test_cases.test_case: Update contact info with valid changes
steps: 2. Modify Street Address, City, State, ZIP, Phone with valid formats
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Profile updated successfully.' and updates displayed profile data

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update profile with invalid ZIP code
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation marks ZIP field invalid and shows error; profile not updated

test_cases.test_case: Update profile with minimal valid phone digits and observe auto-formatting
test_cases.expected_result: Phone auto-formats to '(123) 456-7890' and update succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Request a new Debit card with complete shipping address
steps: 2. In Card Request form select Card Type 'Debit' and choose Account to Link
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Card request submitted successfully.' with a tracking ID; ticket is created

test_cases.test_case: Request card with incomplete shipping address
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error prompts for complete address; request not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Update card controls to freeze an active card
steps: 1. In Manage Cards Card Controls form select the Active card
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Card controls updated successfully.' and card status reflects 'Frozen'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to set spending limit above policy maximum
steps: 2. Enter New Spending Limit exceeding policy (e.g., system max)
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error indicates limit exceeds allowable maximum; update rejected

test_cases.test_case: Add a travel notice with start date equal to today and end date in the past
steps: 2. Enter Travel Notice with Start Date as today and End Date as yesterday
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'End date must be after Start date' shown; no update applied

test_cases.test_case: Execute a Buy trade for an existing fund symbol with sufficient buying power
steps: 1. Navigate to Investments trade funds form
2. Select Action 'Buy', choose Fund Symbol via autocomplete
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Trade executed successfully.' with an order ID; holdings and balances update accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Attempt trade with non-existent fund symbol
steps: 2. Enter Fund Symbol 'FAKE123' that does not exist
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation 'Fund symbol not found' displayed; trade not executed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt sell trade with quantity greater than holdings
preconditions: User holds fewer shares than requested sell quantity
steps: 3. Enter Quantity greater than held shares
4. Select Destination Account and Execute Trade
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Insufficient shares to sell' displayed; trade rejected

test_cases.test_case: Create a monthly recurring investment plan starting in the future meeting minimum contribution
preconditions: Funding account has sufficient balance for initial contribution
steps: 1. In Investments Recurring Investment Plan form select Fund Symbol
3. Select Frequency 'Monthly', choose Start Date in the future
4. Select Funding Account and Click Create Plan
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Plan created successfully.' and schedule is stored

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to create recurring plan with Start Date in the past
steps: 1. Enter Start Date as a past date
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Start date must be in the future' displayed; plan not created

test_cases.test_case: Generate monthly statement for an account
preconditions: Account has transactions in selected period
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Statement generated successfully.' and shows transactions for the period

test_cases.test_case: Generate statement with invalid date range (end before start)
steps: 1. Choose custom date range with End Date earlier than Start Date
2. Select Account and Click Generate Statement
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error indicating invalid date range; no statement generated

test_cases.test_case: Enable e-Statement preference with valid email
steps: 1. In e-Statement preference form check paperless statements box
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'e-Statement preference updated.' and preference is saved

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to save e-Statement preference with invalid email
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation highlights email field with guidance; preference not saved

test_cases.test_case: Change password providing correct current password and valid new password
steps: 3. Enter New Password meeting strength policy
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Password changed successfully.' and credentials updated

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to change password with incorrect current password
steps: 2. Enter valid new password and confirmation
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Current password is incorrect' shown; password not changed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to change password with weak new password
steps: 2. Enter New Password 'weakpwd' that fails policy
3. Enter Confirm New Password and Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error indicating password strength requirements; change rejected

test_cases.test_case: Send a secure message with valid subject, category, and message body
steps: 1. Navigate to Support Center -> Secure Message
3. Select Category 'Account' and enter message body
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Message sent successfully.' with a ticket ID; message appears in support tickets

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to send secure message without message body
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Message body is required' displayed; message not sent

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to attach disallowed file type to secure message
steps: 1. Compose message and attach file with .exe extension
test_cases.expected_result: Attachment validation rejects file and displays guidance; message not sent until attachment removed

test_cases.test_case: Request callback for next business day with valid phone number
steps: 1. Navigate to Support Center -> Schedule Callback
2. Select Reason for Call, pick Preferred Date at least next business day, and a time window
3. Verify Phone Number (edit if necessary) is valid
test_cases.expected_result: Displays 'Callback request submitted.' and an email confirmation is sent; request appears in support queue

test_cases.test_case: Attempt callback request for the same day (not next business day)
steps: 1. Select Preferred Date as today (not next business day)
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Preferred date must be at least the next business day' displayed; request not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Schedule callback with invalid phone number format
steps: 2. Modify Phone Number to '1234' and Click Request Callback
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation indicates invalid phone number; request not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Log out from application
steps: 1. Click Log Out in left-hand navigation
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to sign-in page; session cleared

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to change password to one with exactly minimum required characters meeting complexity
steps: 2. Enter new password exactly 8 characters meeting uppercase, lowercase, number, special
test_cases.expected_result: Password change succeeds and 'Password changed successfully.' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Transfer between two accounts where destination is same as source (self-transfer)
steps: 2. Select same account as Source and Destination
3. Enter a valid amount and Click Transfer
test_cases.expected_result: System either prevents with inline error 'Source and destination cannot be the same' or processes and shows informative message; no balance duplication occurs
